question: Does the Formal 3+3 GENERAL/THOUSAND pool split itself constitute portfolio diversification?

sourceSemantics.formalSelector: GENERAL if scan-date close < NT$1,000; THOUSAND if scan-date close >= NT$1,000
sourceSemantics.journalRecovery: v8_trade_journal_plans.formal_close stores the same plan formalClose sourced from item.close at selection time
sourceSemantics.implication: Historical selected-plan pool identity is PIT-reconstructable without later-price backfill.

frozenMetrics: within-pool projected-risk HHI when >=2 names exist
falsification: Two price-tier pools do not prove statistically independent bets.
A date with only one represented pool is non-identifying for cross-pool diversification.
Even a date with both pools represented cannot establish correlation/covariance diversification without PIT-synchronized return history.
Sector labels, price tier, market cap or nominal share price are forbidden substitutes for D15-03/04 covariance evidence.

maturityRule.L3AllowedIf: Production journal proves PIT-safe pool reconstruction and at least the source/data contract is replayable.
maturityRule.crossPoolEffectClaim: Requires at least one both-pools date for structural cross-pool shares; true diversification/effective-bets still requires D15-03/04/05/06 synchronized history.
maturityRule.L4BlockedUntil: Independent prospective/OOS both-pools dates plus validated dependence evidence.

exactNext: Accumulate the first independent scan dates with GENERAL and THOUSAND both represented. On those dates report price-tier capital/risk shares only; defer true diversification/correlation/effective-bets inference until D15-03/04/05/06 PIT-synchronized return history is authorized.
